items.informal_name: Expansion Homomorphism Scales Monomial Exponents by $ p $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.expand p) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (p • d)) r
items.informal_description: For any exponent vector $ d $ and coefficient $ r $, applying the expansion homomorphism $ \text{expand}_p $ to the monomial with exponent $ d $ and coefficient $ r $ results in the monomial with exponent $ p \cdot d $ and coefficient $ r $.

items.informal_name: bind₁ Applied to a Monomial Yields Product of Substitutions
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = MvPolynomial.C r * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i
items.informal_description: For any substitution function $ f : \sigma \to R[\tau] $, finite exponent vector $ d : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, and coefficient $ r \in R $, applying the variable substitution homomorphism $ \text{bind}_1 $ to the monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, r) $ results in the product of the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ and the product over $ f(i)^{d(i)} $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ d $. Formally, $ \text{bind}_1(f)(\text{monomial}(d, r)) = C(r) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} f(i)^{d(i)} $.

items.informal_name: Bind₂ of Monomial: $ \text{bind₂}(f)(r X^d) = f(r) X^d $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S]
  (f : R →+* MvPolynomial σ S) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₂ f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = f r * (MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to R[\sigma] $, finite support function $ d : \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $, and coefficient $ r \in R $, applying the bind₂ operation to the monomial $ r X^d $ yields $ f(r) X^d $, where $ X^d $ denotes the monomial with exponents specified by $ d $ and coefficient 1.

items.informal_name: Expansion of Monomial: $ rX^q \mapsto rX^{q \cdot p} $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p q : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.expand R p) ((Polynomial.monomial q) r) = (Polynomial.monomial (q * p)) r
items.informal_description: Applying the polynomial expansion operation with parameter $ p $ to the monomial $ rX^q $ results in the monomial $ rX^{q \cdot p} $. This operation scales the exponent $ q $ by $ p $ while preserving the coefficient $ r $.

items.informal_name: Monomial with Summed Exponents Equals Product of Monomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {α : Type u_2} (s : Finset α) (f : α → σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (∑ i ∈ s, f i)) a = MvPolynomial.C a * ∏ i ∈ s, (MvPolynomial.monomial (f i)) 1
items.informal_description: For any finite set $s$, function $f : \alpha \to \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N}$, and coefficient $a \in R$, the monomial with exponent $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)$ and coefficient $a$ is equal to the product of the constant polynomial $C(a)$ and the product of monomials $\prod_{i \in s} \text{monomial}(f(i), 1)$.

items.informal_name: Tensor Product of Multivariate Polynomial Ring with Module Evaluates Monomials as Basis Tensors
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {N : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_3} [inst_1 : CommSemiring S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] [inst_3 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_5 : Module R N] (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : S)
  (n : N) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPolynomial.rTensor ((MvPolynomial.monomial e) s ⊗ₜ[R] n)) d = if e = d then s ⊗ₜ[R] n else 0
items.informal_description: For monomials with exponents $ e $ and $ d $, the tensor product of the multivariate polynomial ring $ S[\sigma] $ with an $ R $-module $ N $, when evaluated at $ d $, applied to the monomial with exponent $ e $ and coefficient $ s $ tensored with $ n $, equals $ s \otimes_R n $ if $ e = d $, and zero otherwise.

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) : (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r * d.prod fun i k => g i ^ k

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_ite_mem_eq
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (q : MvPolynomial σ R) (s : Set σ) [DecidablePred fun x => x ∈ s] [DecidablePred fun x => ↑x.support ⊆ s] : (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => if i ∈ s then MvPolynomial.X i else 0) q = ∑ x ∈ q.support, if ↑x.support ⊆ s then (MvPolynomial.monomial x) (q.coeff x) else 0

items.name: Algebra.Generators.ofComp_toAlgHom_monomial_sumElim
items.type: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {ι' : Type u_3} {T : Type u_7} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (Q : Algebra.Generators S T ι') (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (v₁ : ι' →₀ ℕ) (v₂ : ι →₀ ℕ) (a : R) : (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom ((MvPolynomial.monomial (v₁.sumElim v₂)) a) = (MvPolynomial.monomial v₁) ((MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) ((MvPolynomial.monomial v₂) a))

request.query: Evaluate a multivariate monomial under Kronecker substitution

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : σ → R},
  (MvPolynomial.eval f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = a * s.prod fun n e => f n ^ e

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = f a * s.prod fun n e => g n ^ e

items.name: MvPowerSeries.subst_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
      MvPowerSeries.subst a ((MvPowerSeries.monomial e) r) =
        (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S)) r * e.prod fun s n => a s ^ n

items.name: MvPowerSeries.substAlgHom_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (ha : MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a) (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPowerSeries.substAlgHom ha) ((MvPowerSeries.monomial e) r) =
    (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S)) r * e.prod fun s n => a s ^ n

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r * d.prod fun i k => g i ^ k

items.name: MvPolynomial.bind₁_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = MvPolynomial.C r * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Monomial in Multivariate Polynomial Ring
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = f a * s.prod fun n e => g n ^ e
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and functions $ f : R \to S $ and $ g : \sigma \to S $, evaluating the monomial $ a \cdot \prod_{n \in \sigma} X_n^{s(n)} $ via $ \text{eval}_2 $ yields $ f(a) \cdot \prod_{n \in \text{support}(s)} g(n)^{s(n)} $, where $ s $ is a finite support function representing exponents.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Multivariate Polynomial Monomials via Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = f r * d.prod fun i k => g i ^ k
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $, a type $ \sigma $ of variables, and a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S_1 $ with variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $, the evaluation of the monomial $ X^d \cdot r $ (where $ d : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $ is a finite exponent vector and $ r \in R $) under the evaluation homomorphism $ \mathrm{eval}_2 $ satisfies: $ \mathrm{eval}_2(f, g)(X^d \cdot r) = f(r) \cdot \prod_{i \in \mathrm{support}(d)} g(i)^{d(i)} $. This expresses that monomials are evaluated by applying $ f $ to coefficients and $ g $ to variables, then multiplying the results according to the monomial's structure.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of a Monomial in a Multivariate Polynomial Ring
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : σ → R},
  (MvPolynomial.eval f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = a * s.prod fun n e => f n ^ e
items.informal_description: For a monomial with coefficient $ a $ and exponents specified by a finite support function $ s $, the evaluation under a substitution map $ f : \sigma \to R $ is equal to $ a $ multiplied by the product of $ f(n)^{e} $ for each variable $ n $ with exponent $ e $ in $ s $. Formally, $ \operatorname{eval}_f(\operatorname{monomial}(s, a)) = a \cdot \prod_{n \in \operatorname{support}(s)} f(n)^{s(n)} $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Monomials in Multivariate Polynomial Rings
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r * d.prod fun i k => g i ^ k
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and $ R $-algebra $ S_1 $, given a monomial in $ R[\sigma] $ with coefficient $ r \in R $ and exponent vector $ d : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, the algebra evaluation homomorphism $ \text{aeval}_g $ at a variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ satisfies $ \text{aeval}_g(\text{monomial}(d, r)) = \text{algebraMap}(r) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} (g(i))^{d(i)} $. This expresses that evaluating a monomial replaces each variable $ X_i $ with $ g(i) $, raises it to the power of its exponent $ d(i) $, multiplies these values together, and scales by the algebra-mapped coefficient $ \text{algebraMap}(r) $.

items.informal_name: bind₁ Applied to a Monomial Yields Product of Substitutions
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = MvPolynomial.C r * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i
items.informal_description: For any substitution function $ f : \sigma \to R[\tau] $, finite exponent vector $ d : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, and coefficient $ r \in R $, applying the variable substitution homomorphism $ \text{bind}_1 $ to the monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, r) $ results in the product of the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ and the product over $ f(i)^{d(i)} $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ d $. Formally, $ \text{bind}_1(f)(\text{monomial}(d, r)) = C(r) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} f(i)^{d(i)} $.

items.informal_name: Multiplicative Evaluation of Polynomial-Monomial Product in Multivariate Polynomials
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and semiring $ S_1 $, given a polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $, a monomial with exponents $ s : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ (finite support) and coefficient $ a \in R $, the evaluation of the product $ p \cdot \text{monomial}(s, a) $ using coefficient map $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variable map $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ is equal to the product of the evaluation of $ p $, $ f(a) $, and the product over all $ n \in \text{support}(s) $ of $ g(n)^{s(n)} $.
